name: REA Reverse Engineering
description: Reverse analysis tool based on Reverse Engineer Anything that helps recover key logic, algorithms or API flows. Installing opens a Rex conversation that installs the chosen tier and validates it with real tool calls.
descriptionCn: 基于 Reverse Engineer Anything 的逆向分析工具，帮助还原关键逻辑、算法或接口流程。
author: Flocks Team

reasons: Installing runs rea-agents 6.4.0 through npx, installs the reverse-engineer-anything skill and registers the local MCP service rea; the full tier also installs JDK 21 and Ghidra 12.1.4.
